title.narrative: Care and empowerment for orphans and their families in Nigeria.

description.narrative: 150 beneficiaries received vocational training and in-kind grants to start small businesses. - Establishment of 20 banking kiosk projects. - Distribution of 50 transport vehicles. - 220 orphans benefiting from monthly sponsorships for 12 months.
Providing care for orphans and economic empowerment opportunities for their families in Nigeria. Targeting internally displaced persons (IDPs) and refugees.
The project aims to provide care and sustainable livelihood opportunities for vulnerable groups, particularly IDPs and their families in Abuja and Borno states.
